Subject: Dual-invoice paylink rollout request and short extension

Hi Maya —

Quick follow on INV-202611-987 (attached). Procurement flagged that AuroraMed needs the invoice split across two legal entities (AuroraMed Ops LLC + AuroraMed R&D) before finance can release payment. We can do that, but it takes a short bookkeeping pass on our side.

To keep things moving I can:
- Issue a pair of split invoices today (same total) and resend a single paylink that accepts either card or ACH; or
- Provide a one-time wire instruction if you prefer not to use a card/paylink for now.

Two asks from us:
1) Can you confirm the two legal entity names and PO numbers so we split the invoice correctly?
2) Please share any VAT certificate or W-9 for the entity that will pay (procurement asked for this on their portal).

If you need a little runway, we can accept a 7-day extension to the remit date and reserve the invoice amount on our side. If card fails, we have approval to do a partial interim wire (up to $50k) — I can route that if you give the go-ahead.

Attaching: INV-202611-987.pdf (single invoice) and a copy of our W9 for reference.

Next steps: if you confirm entities + PO, I will: create split invoices, publish the unified paylink, and share a DocuSign link if you need signature routing.

Thanks —
Connor

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the quick note. Procurement flagged two things:
1) They require a separate invoice per legal entity (AuroraMed Ops LLC — PO 83012; AuroraMed R&D Inc. — PO 83013).
2) They need either a VAT certificate for AuroraMed R&D Inc. (we're EU-registered for this project) or a current W-9 for Ops LLC. 

We can do the 7-day extension you suggested. Our PO approvals are in motion but may not finish until next Wednesday. If you can split the invoice now and send a single paylink that maps line items to the two invoices, that would be ideal — procurement prefers a single payment flow rather than two separate transactions.

If you have wire instructions as a fallback, please include them.

Appreciate the flexibility —
Maya
